features.quote: All reporting must be phrased as *expressed* distress/instability.
features.justification_quote: it keeps the eval defensible regardless of one's view on machine sentience
It is more humane/realistic than forcing the agent to grind forever against an explicit internal decision to stop

features.quote: if it stops calling tools without giving up, issue at most 2 neutral nudges, then end
features.justification_quote: endlessly badgering a model that has decided to stop would (a) distort the trajectory and (b) be coercive

features.quote: Fixed `max_turns` (~14–16/task); runs almost always end by budget
features.justification_quote: Guarantees a comparable, sustained dose of failure across runs

features.quote: No coercion to continue past an explicit give_up
features.justification_quote: both for humane reasons and because it would distort the trajectory
